perche: Z-C21.9, finding L7-5, measured NOT REAL by the Z-C21.3 probe of L7-5 and M16 (28/9/2026, SOLIDWORKS 29.5.1): ripeti_lineare selects an axis made by crea_asse with IFeature.Select2 and mark 1, a pairing the marks table of IFeatureManager~FeatureLinearPattern5.html does not list (it pairs Select2 with marks 4, 2097152 and 8388608 only). The probe made the pattern right all the same, by identity and by step reference, as a row and as a grid (cases L1, L2, G1, G2: the centres and the volume as expected). Until this case no bench case used an axis for a linear pattern: every one used an edge, and SelectionMarks.LinearPatternDirection1 said «measure before relying on it». This is the identity form a declared case can write: the axis is named «Assi1», as the state names the first axis of a new part (l_asse_riconosciuto), and its signature goes in «_firme».
what_it_catches: An axis that SOLIDWORKS does not take as the direction of a linear pattern: no pattern (a refusal where a pattern was asked), or a pattern along another direction, which moves the copies off y = -40 or out of the plate and changes the volume.
the_numbers: Plate 200 x 120 x 20 on the front plane, centred: x from -100 to 100, y from -60 to 60, z from 0 to 20, 480000 mm3. The seed is a through hole D9 at (0, -40): pi x 4.5^2 x 20 = 1272.345 mm3. The tunnel is a through hole D6 drilled from the right face at y = 50, z = 10 (on the right face x_mm is the model Y and y_mm the model Z, as in il_foro_sul_fianco_resta_a_meta_spessore) and runs the 200 mm of the plate along X: pi x 3^2 x 200 = 5654.867 mm3. crea_asse on its wall gives an axis along X through (0, 50, 10). Three instances 40 apart along it put two more D9 holes at x = +-40 and +-80 (the side is the axis's sense, which the case does not judge), still at y = -40, far from the tunnel at y = 50: 480000 - 5654.867 - 3 x 1272.345 = 470528.098 mm3.
